bio: Just a few kilometres from Montpellier yet deep in the countryside, this 18C Montpellier retreat is set within a 45ha estate, planted with bamboo groves and home to grazing horses. An old wine storehouse is home to the restaurant, which has a slightly industrial aesthetic. The open kitchen turns out lovely seasonal dishes featuring vegetables, Mediterranean fish and meat from local purebreds – think mussels marinated in fennel or grilled octopus. Surprise lunch set menu and à la carte options.
